featured_reviews.name: Saurabh Shinde
featured_reviews.review_text:
Disappointing Experience at Naveli Dresses

I visited Naveli Dresses with the intention of exploring semi-casual options for my partner. Unfortunately, our shopping experience was marred by the unprofessional behavior of the male owner.

After patiently viewing 4-5 dresses, we were publicly berated for not having a specific item in mind. It even went to a point where he stated - "I'll not show any more dresses if you don't specify what exactly is that you want." The owner's loud and condescending tone was both embarrassing and humiliating, especially given the presence of other customers and staff who seemed amused by the situation.

It's important to remember that not all customers know exactly what they want upfront. Some prefer to explore options before making a decision. A respectful and DISCREET approach would have been more appropriate, especially in a women's clothing store.
Given the rise of e-commerce, businesses that prioritize customer experience and empathy will likely thrive. I hope Naveli Dresses reconsiders its approach to customer service.

featured_reviews.review_text:

featured_reviews.name: Muskan Harpalani
featured_reviews.review_text:
Had a great experience at Pernia’s Pop-Up Shop in Fort — such a beautiful multi-designer store with a really well-curated selection.

What made the visit stand out even more was the service. I was assisted by Prerna, who was incredibly helpful, patient, and genuinely attentive. She made the whole process smooth and enjoyable, without ever feeling pushy.

Everything was handled very professionally, and my order was delivered right on time, exactly as promised — which always makes a big difference.

Overall, a seamless and pleasant shopping experience. Definitely a go-to spot in Mumbai if you’re looking for designer pieces with great service to match.

featured_reviews.name: Pooja Dabhi
featured_reviews.review_text:
I had an amazing experience with Dharshiga at Pernia's Pop-Up Studio, Mumbai. She helped me with my bridal veil, Mehendi outfit, and welcome dinner outfit, and made the entire process seamless from start to finish.

What I appreciated most was that she truly understood my style. I wanted elegant, minimal outfits, and she never tried to oversell flashy or overly embellished pieces. Every recommendation felt thoughtful and perfectly suited to me.

Dharshiga is professional, reliable, and transparent. She kept me updated throughout the customization process, ensured everything fit perfectly, and all deliveries were smooth and on time.

She's also incredibly warm and easy to talk to, which made wedding shopping so much less stressful. I would highly recommend her to any bride looking for honest styling advice and exceptional service.

featured_reviews.name: Nikita
featured_reviews.review_text:
Had the best experience with Pernia's Pop-Up, and a huge shoutout to Bhavika for literally making magic happen.
I was working with a super tight timeline, but she somehow managed to get all my outfits sorted, including custom-designed piece. Every fitting was done perfectly, and she made sure everything fit like a dream despite us having very limited time.
She was incredibly responsive, patient, and genuinely cared about getting every little detail right. Wedding shopping can be stressful, but Bhavika made the whole process feel so easy and enjoyable.
Honestly, I don't know how she pulled it all off, but she absolutely delivered. Couldn't be more grateful. 💗💗

featured_reviews.name: Revathi Nair
featured_reviews.review_text: I had a wonderful experience at Pernia’s Pop-Up Studio, Kala Ghoda, thanks to Shaunak and Neha. They were extremely patient, knowledgeable, and attentive while helping me select outfits for my brother’s wedding functions. They understood my preferences perfectly and suggested styles and designers that suited both the occasions and my personality. Their eye for detail and warm approach made the entire experience smooth and enjoyable. I truly appreciated their dedication and support, and I couldn’t be happier with my selections. Highly recommend working with them!

featured_reviews.name: Bhavini Shah
featured_reviews.review_text:
We had a really good experience at the store !
It’s fabulous and mostly thanks to their in house designers , the staff was really helpful!
Trisha has helped us out , it’s my friends wedding and we had gone to checkout the bridal wear !
She’s been such a great help and she’s quite kind and humble !
She helped my friend with a lot of options and also she helped us trying the outfits as well

It was a really truly a great experience!
It was calm and a very warm experience!

featured_reviews.name: Nimish Mittal
featured_reviews.review_text:
If you need anything menswear - ask for Bhumi at Pernia’s. She is the absolute best. I had a last minute formal event to go to. I got to the store 1 hour before closing and she helped me go through the whole store, try on over a dozen pieces, and even ended up recommending the piece I ultimately chose.

She was a total lifesaver, incredibly patient, and truly knows the designers and collection inside and out.

featured_reviews.name: Maria Hasler
featured_reviews.review_text: I had a wonderful experience working with Sudishka She was incredibly helpful and patient while helping me choose the perfect wedding attire. Her expertise made the entire process so much easier, and her charming personality truly made the experience special. She is absolutely lovely to work with, and I couldn't be happier with her help. Highly recommended🌸

featured_reviews.name: Vidhi Jain
featured_reviews.review_text: I had such a wonderful experience at Pernia’s Pop-Up Studio, Kalaghoda, all thanks to Nidhi Gore. She was incredibly patient, warm, and genuinely supportive throughout the entire process of selecting my Sangeet outfit. From helping me shortlist and finalize the outfit to consistently assisting me over the next two months until it was ready, she was involved at every step. Her dedication, calm approach, and attention to detail made the entire journey smooth and reassuring. I’m truly grateful for her help and for the wonderful service provided by Pernia’s.

featured_reviews.name: KRISHNANDU BHOWMICK
featured_reviews.review_text:
I am absolutely delighted with my shopping experience at this store! The moment I stepped inside, I was struck by the fantastic selection of stylish clothing on offer. From trendy casual wear to elegant formal attire, the store's collection has something for everyone.

But what truly sets this store apart is the exceptional customer service provided by Asad. From the moment I began browsing, Asad was attentive, knowledgeable, and genuinely helpful. He took the time to understand my needs, offered personalized recommendations, and patiently answered all my questions.

Asad's passion for fashion is evident, and his expertise is impressive. He has a keen eye for detail and a deep understanding of what works well together. His suggestions were spot on, and I left the store feeling confident and stylish.

I highly recommend this store to anyone looking for a unique and enjoyable shopping experience. The combination of fantastic products and exceptional customer service makes it a must-visit destination. Asad, thank you for an outstanding shopping experience! I will definitely be back.
